lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 86*-87* included in the PDF)
location_note: Ash-Sheikh neighbourhood, southern ridge of the Mount of Olives above Nahal Kadum; map ref. NIG 22370-78/63122-30, OIG 17370-78/13122-30.
notes: Area A: natural cave with a built Iron II structure (two phases). Area B: quarrying cuts and an exposed rock-hewn burial cave, surveyed and cleaned, empty; no pottery to date Area B.

features.subtype: natural cave (ceiling collapsed) with a built dwelling structure, benches and a round stone installation
features.quote: a natural cave was discovered, whose ceiling had collapsed, probably in antiquity

features.subtype: rock-hewn burial cave, carefully cut facade, door frame, single burial chamber L404 (3 x 3 m), empty
features.quote: burial chamber (3 × 3 m), was surveyed and cleaned

features.subtype: quarrying cuts K, L, M (outlines of rectangular blocks; shallow cut possibly a drying surface or industrial installation)
features.quote: Cuts in the bedrock, probably the result of quarrying, were uncovered here
